text: Read all 11 source files (~3,140 lines) and users' import sites; decided: comment the 73 public class members, the 28 module exports, an @optable kind for aiAccountsOps' 38 ops, and @storedrows kinds for the SQL tables; leave the 90 underscore members (the module's own by its stated convention) uncommented except the two refusal builders; services sql/core/membership/catalogue written as * (no stated kind).

kindsUndetermined.why: Cloudflare's SqlStorage is not a product kind; written *
membership states no kind; written * (and MembershipRefusal written as the shape relied on, ok: boolean as the reader infers it)
ai-catalogue states no kind at this state; written *

kindsUndetermined.what: the translation of AI_ACCOUNT_CHECKS rows, AI_WORDS, DeclaredOp.description

kindsUndetermined.why: the code accepts any value and refuses others; a string kind makes the reader refuse PART_OF_KIND[act.kind] (undefined as an index); written *
membership's registration answers, no stated kind

falseStarts: typed answers as Refusal | Answer with Refusal a plain object kind: the reader refused ~420 property reads in tests and in the module (r.entries on a Refusal); added an index signature to Refusal (a site adds members of its own)
typed ChecksInForce as {checks,sources} | {unreadable: true}: the module's own reads (force.unreadable, force.checks) were refused; rewrote it with ?: undefined members so it discriminates
typed Act.kind as string: PART_OF_KIND[actOf.kind] refused (undefined index); changed to *

typed answers echoing the request's owner/level/provider/plan as string: refused because the request's own is string | null (a guard in an untyped private helper the reader cannot follow); loosened to string | null
corrections: sql made optional in AiAccountsDeps (the constructor defaults its argument to {})
gatewayKeyEnter's key written * with a bound (the code accepts any value and refuses non-strings)
aiAccountsOps' a written AiAccounts | null (a test lists the ops over null)

added @type on four local declarations (base Credential, LimitOf[] out, AccountNotice[] out, sources/s in checksInForce) and on two private fields (_gatewayPort, _disclosureSource), and @returns on private _row, _refuse, _stateOf, _partialOf, _credentialOf, _gatewayHeld, _ceiling, and @param on _hopFor, so the interface's kinds could be checked
notes: Real state: REFUSED (236) = 118 code, 106 tests, 12 rule of form; 622 cannot tell. Commented: REFUSED (514) = 67 code (53 of the real ones gone, 2 new: base.mjs _sealKey encode(this._sealSecret) where the reader cannot follow the _seal() guard, and index.mjs a?.accounts on the dead branch after instanceof), 387 tests (about 280 new: tests read refusal members such as r.reason on the union Refusal | Answer, call with values chosen to be refused (on: 'yes', token: 42), or read r.x of a | null answer), 12 rule of form (JSON.parse of stored JSON columns read as messages, unchanged), 48 (d) bounds without a named test (expected, not fixed); 635 cannot tell. Listing: 'anything' lines 267 -> 356; entries with anything 185 (109 private) -> 264 (110 private) among about 400 entries (was 228): the 90 private _members are left uncommented (the module's own by its stated convention), every answer carries Refusal's index signature (*), and services are *. Clock times are short because the work ran fast in wall time; the effort is in the lines read and written.
